title: Chemical Compounds and Solutions in Biological Research
summary: This cluster consists of various chemical compounds and solutions used in biological research. Leucine, lysine, and histidine are amino acids, while ammonium sulfate, glycerol stocks, and sodium sulfide are chemicals used in laboratory settings. Yeast Nitrogen Base is a chemical used in the preparation of YPD plates, which are a type of agar plate used for growing yeast. Na2S and NaHS are also chemicals related to sodium sulfide, possibly different forms or compounds.
